contexts.text: Rachel = the affection of internal truth with its quality.
Man is first affected with external truths, and afterwards with internal truths; for external truths are the planes of internal truths, being the generals into which singulars are insinuated...
The conjunction of good with the affection of internal truth...

They who are being regenerated learn to know what internal truth is; but at first they do not acknowledge it with such faith as to live according to it; for internal truths are conjoined with spiritual affection, which cannot inflow until external truths have been adapted to correspondence with internal truths. Example(s).
Unless external truths are illustrated by internal truths; that is, by those which are of the internal sense; they present falsities with those who are in evil.
All those conjoin themselves with internal truth as with a harlot who believe in the... literal sense of the Word alone... AC 4874:2.
For the Divine Law is internal truth, and doctrine is external truth; and it is a general rule that internal things inflow into external ones...

For Moses represents the truth of faith which proceeds immediately from the Lord, thus internal truth; but Aaron the truth of faith which proceeds mediately from the Lord, thus external truth. References.
A statute = the external truth of the Church; a judgment = the internal truth of the Church.
Precepts = the internal truths of the Word.

The ten precepts promulgated on Mount Sinai are internal truths; and the laws and statutes which are commanded in the following chapters are external truths. (In both the latter and the former the Lord must reign as to His Divine Human. AC 8864:3.)
The Church at this day is in the internal truths which were represented; for the Lord has revealed these truths. That these truths do not agree with external ones so as to be together. Signified.
Translucent there from internal truths. Signified, Explained.
The internal truths which are of the inaugurating good. Signified, Explained.
To deprive of the internal truths of the Church. Signified.
Frankincense = internal truth; and myrrh = external truth; both from good.
